text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet defeated Vodka in the 
Japanese Derby, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's spirited running, and the image of 
her becoming "Number 1," refused to leave 
her head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined not to fall any further behind 
Vodka, Daiwa Scarlet declared that she 
would defeat her once again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next destination is the Shuka Sho, the 
final leg of the Triple Tiara.
